notes.title: Patch v1.0.0.1
notes.content:
[b]New Feature[/b]: Learn all about the different [b]power-ups[/b] with a new information display in the main menu.

[b]Gameplay Balancing[/b]: We've increased the amount of [b]planetary healing[/b] you get from health drops to give the planet a better chance at survival.

[b]Improved Movement[/b]: Master the battlefield with the new [b]strafing[/b] ability, allowing for more dynamic side-to-side movement.
